verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework, so an official vendor-provided MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence says Mastra lets developers author their own MCP servers that expose their agents and tools. That is a developer building block, not an official first-party MCP server an AI-native user can connect an agent to, so it earns no credit and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Mastra supports authoring Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, exposing agents, tools and other structured resources via the MCP interface.
